name: phpIPAM
description: Web-based IP address management tool for tracking subnets, addresses, and VLANs.

envVars.description: Database password for the phpipam user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      IPAM_DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      IPAM_DATABASE_NAME: phpipam
      IPAM_DATABASE_WEBHOST: "%"
      IPAM_DATABASE_PASS: {{env.IPAM_DATABASE_PASS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/ca:/phpipam/ca
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: phpipam
      MYSQL_USER: phpipam
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.IPAM_DATABASE_PASS}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.IPAM_DATABASE_PASS}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-cron:
    image: phpipam/phpipam-cron:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-cron
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      IPAM_DATABASE_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      IPAM_DATABASE_PASS: {{env.IPAM_DATABASE_PASS}}
      IPAM_DATABASE_NAME: phpipam
      SCAN_INTERVAL: 1h
